files.App.svelte:
<script lang="ts">
  import ProductList from './ProductList.svelte';
  import Cart from './Cart.svelte';

  type Product = { id: number; name: string; price: number };
  type CartItem = { product: Product; qty: number };

  const products: Product[] = [
    { id: 1, name: 'Remera', price: 12500.5 },
    { id: 2, name: 'Zapatillas', price: 48999.99 },
    { id: 3, name: 'Gorra', price: 7800 }
  ];

  let cart = $state<CartItem[]>([]);

  const total = $derived(
    cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.product.price * item.qty, 0)
  );

  function add(product: Product) {
    const existing = cart.find((i) => i.product.id === product.id);
    if (existing) {
      existing.qty += 1;
    } else {
      cart.push({ product, qty: 1 });
    }
  }

  function increment(id: number) {
    const item = cart.find((i) => i.product.id === id);
    if (item) item.qty += 1;
  }

  function decrement(id: number) {
    const item = cart.find((i) => i.product.id === id);
    if (!item) return;
    item.qty -= 1;
    if (item.qty <= 0) {
      cart = cart.filter((i) => i.product.id !== id);
    }
  }
</script>

<main class="mx-auto grid max-w-3xl gap-8 p-6 md:grid-cols-2">
  <ProductList {products} onAdd={add} />
  <Cart items={cart} {total} onIncrement={increment} onDecrement={decrement} />
</main>
